review_description: Installation very professional. Started on time. Knew what they were doing good crew, working brilliantly saving money first electricity bill yep!  Can not be happier !!!!great team effort would recommend Solarlink Aus to our friends great work to all involvedTim Ryan FTG Melb

Once you decide and pay and install a $17,000 solar system I think its ABSOLUTELY  UNACCEPTABLE THAT RED ENERGY and JEMENA quote 4 to 6 weeks to (reconfigure a smart meter?)I'm sorry did we just use the word SMART?????
